newsitem.title: USA: Maine school districts fret over funding formula.
newsitem.headline: Maine school districts fret over funding formula.

text.p: School districts in southern and coastal Maine say they are not getting a fair shake from the school funding formula.
Representatives from those areas have formed the Coalition for Equitable School Funding and are pushing for a change that would weigh income more and the property value of a community less.

School officials in the northern part of the state are upset at the proposal. Many argue the formula is tilted against them. Lawmakers are considering several bills to change the way the state distributes school aid.
